reflection_definition: Cloudy native inward gas continuum + inward lines, reflected incident continuum excluded; XSTAR native emit_inward; each divided by native incident spectrum
ratio_definition: XSTAR/Cloudy at identical native energy-bin centres; reflected oxygen zoom uses endpoint-normalized reflectances; other panels use native quantities; no smoothing

reflected_oxygen_zoom_normalization.definition: R(E) / ((R(0.55 keV)+R(0.75 keV))/2), independently for each model
reflected_oxygen_zoom_normalization.endpoint_interpolation: Linear; native samples retained in spectra and ratios

temperature_annotations: back-face temperature on transmission panel; illuminated-face temperature on reflection panel
parameters: XSTAR vturbi=200 km/s; Cloudy turbulence=200 km/s; nH=1e15, NH=1e21, logxi=3
